source: The FuseZap engine repository (private). Commits are named by id; references without one were read at the engine’s main on the snapshot day (9b31ca4).
redaction: Text files are published as they are in the repository, except that API keys and tokens, IP addresses, private hostnames, instance, pod and container ids, home-directory paths and e-mail addresses are replaced with <redacted>. sha256 is the published file’s; source_sha256, where given, is the original’s.

files.shows: Notes on the confirmation run of Qwen2.5-7B in bf16 on both NeuronCores: time to first token by prompt length, time per output token and the Validate verdicts.
The job summary: the bf16 accuracy bar, the served Validate runs, the in-process timings, the chunked-prefill bit check and the comparison with AWS NxD Inference on the same instance.
